// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// A magic token value is a sign-in link. Reading one is signing in as that
// parent (amendment C1).
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function pendingLinks(parentId) {
  return db.magicToken.findMany({ where: { parentId }, select: { expiresAt: true } });
}
